question: What capacity per gram of sulfur did the cathode deliver at cycle 1500 at 1C, and what share is that of the reversible capacity it showed at 1C in the rate test?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%1500%' OR text ILIKE '%1 C%' OR text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%rate%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh%' ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE (page=5 AND line_no BETWEEN 84 AND 106) OR (page=5 AND id IN ('p5.L86','p5.L87','p5.L88')) ORDER BY page, line_no

SELECT CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L103'), '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS cycle1500_cap, CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L87'), '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS rate1C_cap, (CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L103'), '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p5.L87'), '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE)) AS share

SELECT 100.0 * CAST(regexp_extract(a.text, '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(regexp_extract(b.text, '([0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM lines a, lines b WHERE a.id='p5.L103' AND b.id='p5.L87'
